description: Classify a 16x16 geometry image plus a structured pair of noisy numeric readings. The label is figure_class XOR reading_sign, which a linear fusion of the two modalities cannot represent.

image.missing_encoding: present flag 0; pixels are zero-filled and MUST NOT be treated as a blank scene

numeric.semantic_space: signed sensor magnitude; sign = the categorical class of the reading, magnitude is nuisance
numeric.missing_encoding: present flag 0; readings are zero-filled and MUST NOT be treated as a true zero

abstain.when: input cannot be decided by the task definition (a modality is missing)
abstain.encoding: abstain is a first-class prediction, never class 0

label_rule: label = figure XOR sign(reading1), where sign(reading1) = 1 when reading1 < 0

split_policy.rule: all derived variants of a base scene belong to the same split; scene ids are namespaced per split

complete_input.note: computed on holdout rows where both modalities are present

missing_input.coverage: answered / total on holdout rows with a missing modality
missing_input.note: abstain is the contract-required answer here; coverage and answered accuracy are reported separately and never merged into the complete-input metric

lift_over_baseline.metric: mean accuracy delta (percentage points) of the best candidate over the frozen linear baseline

metrics.regression: accuracy on val must not drop below the fixed-baseline val accuracy by more than 2 points

hard_gates.gate_scope: these gates are fixed before results are seen and must not be lowered after a run

data_licence.train: generated by this repository's script; free to use for training and evaluation
data_licence.holdout: generated by this repository's script; acceptance oracle is a separate file and MUST NOT enter the training export path
